name: Final Verse
desc: When its HP falls to a third or less, moves of its primary type hit 50% harder.

name: Deep Resonance
desc: Moves matching the zone's attunement are boosted ×1.2 instead of ×1.1.

name: Crackle Plating
desc: Kin that strike it with contact moves may be Jolted (30%).

name: Ember Hide
desc: Kin that strike it with contact moves may be Scorched (30%).

name: Blight Skin
desc: Kin that strike it with contact moves may be Blighted (30%).

name: Rime Hide
desc: Kin that strike it with contact moves may get Rimebite (30%).

name: Thorned
desc: Kin that strike it with contact moves lose 1/8 of their max HP.

name: Looming
desc: On entry, lowers the opposing kin's Attack by one stage.

name: Held Note
desc: Its stats cannot be lowered by the opposing kin.

name: Keystone Core
desc: At full HP it survives any single hit with 1 HP.

name: Sharp Ear
desc: Its critical-hit chance is raised one stage.

name: Quick Pecks
desc: Moves of power 60 or less gain 50% power.

name: Headlong
desc: Moves with recoil gain 20% power.

name: Regrowth
desc: Recovers 1/16 of its max HP at the end of each turn.

name: Lode Sink
desc: Electric moves have no effect and heal it instead; cannot be Jolted.

name: Tide Sink
desc: Water moves have no effect and heal it instead.

name: Kiln Heart
desc: Fire moves have no effect and stoke its own fire moves ×1.5; cannot be Scorched.

name: Rain Glide
desc: Speed doubles in rain.

name: Sun Bask
desc: Speed doubles in sunlight.

name: Rimeguard
desc: Physical Defense ×1.5 in snow.

name: Fog Veil
desc: In fog, moves aimed at it are less accurate.

name: Restless Molt
desc: 30% chance each turn to shake off a lingering condition.

name: Light Sleeper
desc: Wakes from Drowse twice as fast.

name: Attuned Style
desc: Its same-type bonus is ×2 instead of ×1.5.

name: Weatherwool
desc: Takes half damage from fire and frost moves.

name: Frantic Stride
desc: While afflicted by a condition, Speed ×1.5 and Jolt no longer slows it.
